summaries.workflow-ai: Software Development Engineer III - Workflow AI with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in JavaScript/Node.js backend development, AI-powered automation, custom AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Built a RAG-based AI agent with a vector-database-backed knowledge base and a multi-agent automation workflow at Turbot HQ, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90% through AI-driven automation.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK to orchestrate custom AI agents that generate cloud preventive-policy automation commands, validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score outcomes against an internal metric — an end-to-end AI-powered automation pipeline for complex tasks.

Built a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent with a knowledge base spanning documentation and code for all internal repositories, ingested into S3 vector storage; deployed to AWS Lambda and integrated with the Slack Bot API to deliver context-aware, AI-driven answers to cross-team queries.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and PR creation — integrating AI directly into code-execution automation actions; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to event-driven eventing, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via templating, keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes at scale; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures.
Mentored teammates on adopting AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code, Cursor) into their daily workflows.
